| Default Port | http\://localhost:5174 |

#### **2.1.3 Database Server**

| Item | Specification |
| :---- | :---- |
| Database Engine | Microsoft SQL Server 2022 |
| Management Tools | SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS 20.x) |
| Logical Database | EELPM – main application database for EELPM. |
| RAM | 2 GB minimum dedicated to SQL Server |

#### **2.1.4 Third-Party Services Configuration**

| Service | Purpose | Key Configuration |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| JWT | Authentication & Authorization | JWT\_Secret Key, JWT\_Issuer, JWT\_Audience |
| Cloudinary | File & avatar storage | CLOUDINARY\_CloundName, CLOUND\_ApiKey, CLOUDINARY\_ApiSecret |
| Google OAuth 2.0 | Google Sign-in | Google\_ClientId, Google\_ClientSecret |
| SMTP(Gmail) | Email notification | SMTP\_Email, SMTP\_Password, Port:587 |
| FAP API (Mock) | Sync academic data | FAP Mock endpoint configured in appsettings.json |

Note: 

- The FAP API integration is currently simulated via FapMockController during the development phase, as the team has not yet established contact with FPT's IT department to obtain access to the actual FPT Academic Portal system. The mock endpoint replicates the FAP data synchronization flow for academic data  
- The FEID OAuth 2.0 integration is currently simulated via FeidOAuthController during the development phase, as the team has not yet established contact with FPT's IT department to obtain access to the actual FPT Education ID identity server. The mock endpoint replicates the FEID authentication flow..

### **2.2 Installation Instruction**

#### **2.2.1 System Components \- Installation Overview**

| Component | Environment | Technology | Summary |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Backend API | Windows / Ubuntu 20.04, .NET 8 | 2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 10 GB storage | ASP.NET Core 8, runs on Kestrel. Optionally proxied via Nginx for HTTPS. |
| Frontend Web | Windows / Ubuntu 20.04, Node.js 20 | SvelteKit SPA | Built as a static SPA; served via Node dev server or Nginx. |
| Database Server | Windows, SQL Server 2022 | 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM (min) | EELPMFPT database created and populated via SQL schema script. |

#### **2.2.2 Database Installation**

| Item | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Database Engine | Microsoft SQL Server 2022 |
| Database Name | EELPMFPT |
| Deployment Method | Execute SQL schema script: EELPM\_SQLServerSchema.sql |
| Permissions | SQL login with db\_owner privileges on EELPMFPT |
| Management Tool | SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) 20.x |

Step-by-step Database Setup:

1. Open SSMS → Connect to Server (localhost or .) using SQL Server Authentication.  
2. Right-click Databases → New Database → enter name EELPMFPT → click OK.  
3. Open EELPM\_SQLServerSchema.sql in SSMS. Ensure EELPMFPT is the selected database.  
4. Press F5 to execute. Verify all tables appear under EELPMFPT \> Tables.

#### **2.2.3 Backend Installation**

| Item | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Runtime | .NET SDK 8.0, ASP.NET Core 8.0 |
| Repository | https\://github.com/sep490g72/EXEMan.git |
| Configuration | appsettings.json \- fill in DB connection string and third-party service keys |
| Default Port | http\://localhost:7231 |
| API Docs | http\://localhost:7231/swagger/index.html |

Step-by-step Backend Setup:

1. Clone the repository: git clone [https\://github.com/sep490g72/EXEMan.git](https://github.com/sep490g72/EXEMan.git)  
2. Open EXEManSp26.sln in Visual Studio 2022\.  
3. Configure appsettings.json: fill in ConnectionStrings, JWT, Cloudinary, SMTP, and Google OAuth values.  
4. Restore dependencies: run dotnet restore (or press F5 in Visual Studio 2022).  
5. Verify: open http\://localhost:7231/swagger/index.html \- Swagger UI should load with all API endpoints listed.

#### **2.2.4 Frontend Installation**

| Item | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Framework | SvelteKit (TypeScript \+ TailwindCSS) |
| Repository | https\://github.com/khazuuman/EELPMFE.git |
| Package Manager | pnpm |
| Default Port | http\://localhost:5174 |

1. Install dependencies: pnpm install  
2. Copy .env.example to .env and fill in: VITE\_API\_BASE\_URL=[http\://localhost:7231](http://localhost:7231)  
3. Start the development server: pnpm dev  
4. Verify: open http\://localhost:5174 \- the EELPM-FPT login page should appear.

## **3\. User Manual** {#3.-user-manual}

### **3.1 Overview**

EELPM-FPT (Experiential Entrepreneurship Learning Process Management for FPT University Students) is a web-based platform designed to manage the full lifecycle of the EXE101 and EXE201 courses at FPT University. The system facilitates collaboration between students, lecturers, mentors, and academic staff throughout the entire process \- from group formation and project topic registration to assignment submission, mentoring, and final project delivery.

The platform is built on a modern technology stack: a C\# .NET 8 RESTful API backend with Microsoft SQL Server 2022, a SvelteKit frontend, SignalR for real-time communication, Google OAuth and JWT for authentication, and SMTP email notifications. Academic data is synchronized with the FAP portal to ensure accuracy of student, class, and lecturer information

#### **3.1.1 System Actor**

| Role | Access Level | Responsibilities |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Student | Group Member | View class/group info; send/cancel join requests; respond to invitations; view group topic history; chat with group; view announcements. |
| Leader | Group Leader (extends Student) | All Student actions plus: manage group members (invite/kick/approve requests), edit group info, submit group for approval, register/update/resubmit/change project topic, submit assignments. |
| Lecturer | Class Instructor | Manage class settings; set deadlines; create/edit groups; approve/reject groups and topics; create assignments; grade submissions; send announcements; assign mentors. |
| Mentor | External Advisor | View assigned groups and progress; schedule and manage meetings; participate in group chat; view assignment timelines and submissions. |
| Academic Staff | Administrative Staff | Manage courses and grade items; synchronize data from FAP system; manage class listings; send announcements. |
| Admin | System Administrator | Full system access: manage user accounts and roles, monitor system health, configure system settings. |

#### **3.1.2 Main Feature**

| No. | Module | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Authentication & Authorization | Login with FEID or Google OAuth (fpt.edu.vn / fe.edu.vn only). JWT session management with role-based access control. |
| 2 | Profile Management | View and update personal profile including avatar and contact details. |
| 3 | Class Management | Lecturers manage class details, set deadlines, view student lists, and manage assignment timelines. |
| 4 | Group Management | Lecturer-created or auto-allocated groups. Students join via requests or invitations. Leaders manage membership and submit groups for approval. |
| 5 | Project Topic Management | Leaders register project topics for lecturer approval. Supports topic updates, resubmission after rejection, and topic change requests after approval. |
| 6 | Assignment Management | Lecturers create assignments with deadlines. Groups submit files; lecturers grade and provide feedback. |
| 7 | Announcement Management | Academic staff and lecturers publish announcements targeted to specific classes or roles. |
| 8 | Meeting Management | Lecturers and mentors schedule meeting sessions with date, time, mode, and Google Meet link. |
| 9 | Chat Management | Real-time group messaging via SignalR. Members send text messages and upload files. |
| 10 | Mentor Management | Academic staff import and manage mentor profiles. Lecturers assign mentors to approved groups (max 5 groups per mentor). |
| 11 | Import & Sync | Import mentor/student data from Excel files. Sync class, student, lecturer, and campus data from the FAP system. |
| 12 | Export | Lecturers export class grade reports to Excel, consolidating all assignment scores for all groups. |

#### **3.1.2 System Workflow Overview**

| Phase | Activity | Actors | Detail |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | System Setup | Academic Staff / Admin | Create semesters and campuses. Import or sync students, lecturers, and class data from FAP. |
| 2 | Class Preparation | Lecturer | Review class roster. Set Group Formation Deadline and Topic Registration Deadline. |
| 3 | Group Formation | Lecturer / Student | The lecturer creates groups manually or auto-allocates. Students join via requests or invitations. The leader submits the group for approval. |
| 4 | Group Approval | Lecturer | Review submitted groups. Approve or reject with feedback. Publish all groups to make them visible to students. |
| 5 | Mentor Assignment | Lecturer | Assign a mentor to each approved group (max 5 groups per mentor). |
| 6 | Topic Registration | Leader / Lecturer | Leader registers project topic. The lecturer approves or rejects. The leader can resubmit after rejection or request a change after approval. |
| 7 | Assignment Cycle | Lecturer / Group | The lecturer creates assignments with deadlines. Groups submit files. Lecturer grades and provides feedback. |
| 8 | Mentoring Meetings | Mentor / Group | Mentors schedule meetings, monitor group progress, and communicate via group chat. |
| 9 | Communication | All roles | Announcements, notifications, and real-time group chat keep all members aligned throughout the project. |

### **3.2 User Manual \- Home page/Authentication**

All users authenticate before accessing their role-specific dashboard. Two methods are supported.

* FEID login – for accounts provisioned by the administrator  
* Google OAuth 2.0 – only @fpt.edu.vn and @fe.edu.vn domains are accepted  
  ![][image138]

### **3.3 User Manual \- Lecturer Side**

Lecturers manage the full lifecycle of a class: from group formation and topic approval to assignment grading and mentor assignment. After login, the system redirects to the Lecturer Portal (Class list dashboard)

#### **3.3.1. Class & Group Management**

* View class detail and student roster  
  ![][image139]

* Auto-allocate groups (system ensures major diversity) or create groups manually  
  ![][image140]

* Edit group members; delete a group  
  ![][image141]

* Set Group Formation Deadline and Topic Registration Deadline  
  ![][image142]

* Publish all groups – makes groups visible to students  
  ![][image143]

* View unassigned student list  
  ![][image144]

#### **3.3.2. Group & Topic Approval**

Once students submit their groups and project topics, lecturers review and approve or reject them.

* Approve / Reject a submitted group  
  ![][image145]

* Approve / Reject a submitted project topic

![][image146]

* Approve / Reject a topic change request

![][image147]

* View full topic change history per group

![][image148]

#### **3.3.3. Assignment & Grade Management**

Lecturers create checkpoints/assignments, grade group submissions, and export final grades.

* Create Assignment / Checkpoint (title, due date, max score, attachments)

![][image149]

* Edit or delete an existing assignment  
  ![][image150]

* View group submissions and enter scores with feedback

![][image151]

* Export class grade report to Excel  
  ![][image152]

#### **3.3.4. Mentor Assignment & Communication**

After group approval, lecturers assign a mentor to each group and can chat directly with groups.

* Assign mentor to group (from existing mentor list or by email/name)  
  ![][image153]

* Real-time chat with any group in the class (text \+ file upload)

![][image154]

### **3.4 User Manual \- Student Side**

Students participate in the class, join a group, and collaborate on project work. After login, students land on the Student Dashboard showing their class and group status.

#### **3.4.1. Class & Group Discovery**

Students can explore the class environment and find available groups to join.

* View class details and full student list

![][image155]

* View all groups in the class with member information

![][image156]

* View group formation and topic registration deadline notifications  
  ![][image157]

#### **3.4.2. Group Formation**

Students join a group by sending a request or accepting an invitation from a Group Leader.

* Send a join request to a group

![][image158]

* View and cancel pending join requests

![][image159]

* View incoming group invitations

![][image160]

* Accept or reject a group invitation

![][image161]

#### **3.4.3. View Assignment**

Students view assignments published by the lecturer.

* View assignment list with deadlines and descriptions

![][image162]

#### **3.4.4. Communication**

![][image163]

### **3.5 User Manual \- Leader Side**

The Group Leader inherits all Student permissions and gains additional authority to manage group membership, register the project topic, formally submit the group for lecturer approval, and submit assignment

#### **3.5.1 Group Administration**

Leaders manage who is in the group and formally submit the group when ready.

* Approve or reject incoming join requests from students

![][image164]

* Invite specific students to the group

![][image165]

* Submit group for lecturer approval

![][image166]

#### **3.5.2 Project Topic Management**

Leaders register, update, resubmit, or request a change of the group's project topic.

* Register a new project topic (title, description, objective, project logo)

![][image167]

* Update topic while it is still pending lecturer review

![][image168]

* Resubmit topic after it has been rejected

![][image169]

* Submit a topic change request after the topic has been approved

![][image170]

#### **3.5.2 Submit Assignment**

Leaders view assignments published by the lecturer and submit files before the deadline.

* View assignment list with deadlines and descriptions

![][image162]

* Submit assignment (upload files)

![][image171]

### **3.6 User Manual \- Mentor Side**

Mentors are external advisors assigned to one or more groups (up to 5). They monitor group progress and communicate through scheduled meetings and group chat.

#### **3.6.1 Group monitoring**

Mentors have a read-only view of their assigned groups' details, members, topic, checkpoints, and assignment submissions.

* View list of all assigned groups

![][image172]

* View group detail: members, project topic, checkpoint list, and submission timeline

![][image173]

#### **3.6.2 Chat with the group**

![][image174]

### **3.7 User Manual \- Academic Staff Side**

Academic Staff handles administrative setup for the system: managing semesters, courses, grade structures, lecturer data, and announcements. Data can be imported from Excel or synced directly from the FAP academic system.

#### **3.7.1 Academic Data Management**

Staff sync or import data from the FAP system to keep class, student, and lecturer records accurate.

* Sync academic data from FAP (select course → click Sync)

![][image175]

* View Lecturer list, Student list, Mentor list, Topic list, Report

![][image176]

#### **3.7.2 Course & Grade Item Management**

Staff define the course catalogue and configure grade item weights used for assessment.

* View course list and course detail with grade items

![][image177]

* Create / Update / Delete a Course (code, name, credits)  
  ![][image178]

* Create / Update / Delete Grade Items (name, weight percentage)

![][image179]

#### **3.7.3 Announcement Management**

Staff publish system-wide announcements targeted to specific roles or classes.

* Create/Update/Delete announcement

Administrators have full system access. Their primary responsibilities include managing academic staff and configuring system email settings

* Create/Update/Delete academic staff
